This specific error arises because the `subsys/retention/retention.c` file in the Zephyr RTOS source tree incorrectly uses `DT_FOREACH_STATUS_OKAY`. The `DT_FOREACH_STATUS_OKAY` macro expects the compatible string as its first argument. While `zephyr_library_dts_compatible(zephyr,retention)` in the `CMakeLists.txt` correctly registers the compatible, the C code should use `DT_DRV_COMPAT(zephyr_retention)` to expand to the actual string `"zephyr,retention"`.

The current code `DT_FOREACH_STATUS_OKAY(zephyr_retention, ...)` passes `zephyr_retention` as an identifier, not the string literal, leading to the build system failing to correctly process the device tree nodes and generate the necessary device structures, hence the undefined reference.

The fix involves modifying the `subsys/retention/retention.c` file within your Zephyr installation to correctly use `DT_DRV_COMPAT`.
